title: Fix verify-lean extraction after field delayed product-sum hooks
description:
`./scripts/verify-lean.sh` currently reaches Charon/Aeneas after the field-batch work, but the generated Lean build fails around `mul_product_sum_wide` / `reduce_product_sum_wide` projections for `FiniteField` implementations. `cd proofs && lake build` passes on the committed Lean sources after restoring failed generated artifacts, so this is a full extraction/post-processing regression rather than a committed-proof build failure.

## Background

The field-batch parent `2c866544` and C3 `86c09a51` touched `gfp/` and field delayed-reduction hooks. A parent-story review required full `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` evidence. The lead fixed a Rust `verify_lean` cfg compile regression in `gfpn::batch`, after which the script reached Aeneas/Lake but failed on generated Lean projection errors involving the new delayed product-sum trait methods.

Per user decision, the field-batch parent may close using committed `cd proofs && lake build` evidence, while this issue tracks restoring the full Charon -> Aeneas -> Lake extraction pipeline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` passes from repository root on current mainline.
- [hard] The fix keeps exercising intended production `gfp/` and `gfpn/` arithmetic; do not hide relevant field arithmetic behind broad opaque/exclude rules just to make extraction pass.
- [hard] Any Aeneas/Charon compatibility workaround is narrowly scoped and documented in `scripts/verify-lean.sh` and/or `proofs/WORKAROUNDS.md`.
- [hard] `cd proofs && lake build` still passes.
- [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-core --all-features --release --profile ci` passes.
- [hard] `cargo clippy -p gf2-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes.
